title: PLC Ladder Logic for Pneumatic Actuators

content.objective: To design, simulate, and deploy an automated pick-and-place ladder logic sequence using a Siemens S7-1200 PLC and double-acting pneumatic cylinders.
apparatus: Double-acting pneumatic cylinders with magnetic reed sensors
content.theory: Electro-pneumatic automation utilizes discrete 24V DC signals from PLC output relays to actuate solenoid coils, shifting spool valves that direct pressurized air to cylinder chambers.
procedure: Wire the magnetic cylinder limit switches (A0, A1, B0, B1) to PLC digital inputs %I0.0 through %I0.3.
Connect 5/2 solenoid coils to PLC digital outputs %Q0.0 through %Q0.3.
Write a cascaded ladder program in TIA Portal implementing the motion sequence A+ B+ A- B-.
Download logic to CPU and verify emergency-stop interlocking functionality.
content.conclusion: The ladder sequence executed cleanly with zero positional overlap. Cycle repeat time averaged 3.2 seconds without pressure drops.
